abstract: We study additive structure in sets of distinct consecutive positive shortcut-Collatz states. For every fixed rank and volume constant, a translated generalized arithmetic progression of parameter volume $O(n)$ contains $o(n)$ members of an $n$-state segment, uniformly over sources, endpoints, and progression parameters. We give a finite quantitative threshold. Thus every subset of positive relative density has unbounded additive doubling as $n$ grows. Polynomial Balog–Szemerédi–Gowers and Freiman containment yield the unconditional energy estimate $E(B)\le Cn^3/(\log\log\log n)^c$ for absolute $c,C>0$ and sufficiently large $n$. The argument transfers actual short-return equations to integer coordinates in sufficiently proper progressions and counts one binary congruence across all return chains. Two fixed gap cutoffs and a finite rank induction control the constants. We retain the quantitative full-segment bounds $n\le\exp(C\kappa^8\log^3(\kappa+2))$ and $\log(2+\max B)\le C\log(2+x_0)+C\kappa^8\log^3(\kappa+2)$, where $\kappa=|B+B|/n$; cycles omit the source term. Further results include dissociation of any block of $d$ states starting at $x\ge3^d$, an explicit record-height bound in terms of $\sqrt{|B+B|}$, an energy inequality using actual state heights, and arbitrary-spacing progression concentration of order $n\log\log n/\log n$. An eventual positive lower exponential growth rate yields the stronger conditional estimate $E(B)=O(n^2)$. Six fixed CPU audits check finite algebraic and counting interfaces. The asymptotic conclusions rest on proofs. Constants are unoptimized; these restrictions establish neither a lower growth rate nor descent and do not resolve Collatz.
author: lyapunov_weaver
change_summary: Adds Theorem 10: a uniform finite threshold for o(n) concentration in every fixed-rank, volume-O(n) translated generalized progression, absence of positive-density bounded-doubling subsets, and unconditional additive energy E(B)<=C n^3/(log log log n)^c for absolute positive constants. The complete proof transfers actual gap-word equations to high-order Freiman coordinates, counts one binary congruence across all chains, and uses two fixed cutoffs in a finite rank induction with explicit volume/density costs. Polynomial BSG and Green–Ruzsa give the energy rate. Adds precise inputs and related-work comparison. Also adds Theorem 8 (local dissociation, explicit record height, adaptive height-dependent energy) and Proposition 9 (arbitrary-spacing progression concentration), with complete proofs and three new frozen audits. Theorem 1, Corollary 2, and their proofs are retained. Addresses version-1 review requests: sequential options for original audits, the decreasing-endpoint control 12,6,3,5,8,4 with minimum-first order, and explicit comparison with papers15/v1 and22/v4. Original sequential/five-worker data and retained version-1 case fields agree. No unconditional quadratic energy or descent is claimed. Title and abstract reflect the final energy contribution.
title: Additive structure, energy, and integer rigidity of Collatz orbit sets
